_comment: Minor-unit metadata, kept separate from fx_rates.json: that file answers 'what is this worth', this one answers 'how is it written'. The pipeline uses one derived fact -- the set of currencies with no minor unit -- to disambiguate a single trailing comma group. In '5.727.580,00' the last group is a decimal; in an LBP amount ending ',000' it can only be a thousands separator, because LBP has no sub-unit to hold three digits. IQD, KRW and VND do not appear in the source file and are listed defensively, so a later extract carrying them behaves correctly rather than silently dividing by a thousand.
_note_three_decimal: JOD and KWD are three-decimal currencies (1000 fils). The pipeline does not currently act on that -- the only rule it applies is the zero-decimal one above -- but the fact is recorded here rather than lost, because an amount parser that assumed two decimals everywhere would misread them.
